name: facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels/contrib/urdf/SceneGraph/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.create_meshnode: create a MeshNode instance to hold and manage 3D triangle mesh data
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.addMesh: add an open3d triangle mesh object to the MeshNode, combining it with any existing mesh
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.addMeshFile: load a mesh from an OBJ file, paint it a uniform color, and add it to the MeshNode
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.getMesh: get a deep copy of the stored mesh transformed by a world matrix for rendering
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.review_MeshNode: review the MeshNode class and its mesh management methods for 3D scene graph usage

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.construct_scene_graph: create a SceneGraph from a root URDF link with optional joint angles to build a hierarchical scene
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.update_scene_state: update the SceneGraph state by recursively applying joint rotations and translations to all nodes
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.get_meshes: get all Open3D meshes from the SceneGraph after updating transforms for visualization
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.update_joint_angles: update joint angles on the SceneGraph from a PyTorch tensor to reconfigure the robot pose
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.extract_rpy: extract roll-pitch-yaw rotation values for a scene node based on its joint axis and angle

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.create_scene_node_hierarchy: create a SceneNode with parent-child relationships and update world matrices for the entire hierarchy
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.add_mesh_to_scene_node: add an Open3D mesh to a SceneNode and retrieve the transformed mesh using getMesh
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.translate_scene_node: translate a SceneNode in 3D space by applying a translation vector to its local transform
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.rotate_scene_node_by_axis: rotate a SceneNode around an arbitrary axis by a specified angle in radians
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.scale_scene_node: scale a SceneNode uniformly or non-uniformly by applying a scale factor to its local transform

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.create_Transform: create a Transform instance that initializes identity matrices for translation, rotation, and scale
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.build_getMatrix: build a call to getMatrix that returns the combined 4x4 transformation matrix
